name: doc-to-markdown
description: Converts DOCX/PDF/PPTX to high-quality Markdown with automatic post-processing. Fixes pandoc grid tables, simple tables, image paths, CJK bold spacing, attribute noise, and code blocks; for PDFs also strips OCR garbage blocks, repeated headers/footers/watermarks, and absolute image paths from pymupdf4llm output. Benchmarked best-in-class (7.6/10) against Docling, MarkItDown, Pandoc raw, and Mammoth. Trigger on "convert document", "docx to markdown", "parse word", "doc to markdown", "解析word", "转换
author: daymade
summary_zh: 一款将 DOCX、PDF 和 PPTX 高质量转为 Markdown 的工具，适合清理表格、图片路径及 OCR 杂质。
